description.html: The combined 80x45x40 cm aqua-terrarium joins a land section and a water section in one glass enclosure. The water section lets you keep semi-aquatic species that need access to water for swimming and soaking, while the land section is for resting and basking under a heat lamp.

With a floor area of 80x45 cm, this terrarium allows natural movement for ground-dwelling species and proper temperature zoning: a warm spot under the spot lamp and a cooler area on the opposite side. Mesh-covered ventilation openings provide constant air circulation without letting insects or small animals through.
Aqua-terrariums are designed for species that need both a land and a water section in their habitat:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: Every terrarium we make is handmade, so you can choose the dimensions, film color, ventilation type and 3D background style. We also build fully custom models to your needs, so contact us for a consultation. Delivery throughout Serbia.
